notablePrerequisites: You control a creature that can attack this turn.
description:
Declare any creature as an attacker. Mr. Orfeo triggers, doubling Malignus's power.
Cast Chandra's Ignition by paying {3}{R}{R}, causing Malignus to deal damage equal to its power to each other creature and each opponent.
Each opponent loses the game due to having 0 life.
